title: Kissed Yeasty Spanish Yogurt Crema Catalana
description: A creamy and yeasty post-workout Spanish dish featuring ssamjang, this Crema Catalana is a low-sodium friendly dessert, with a brine-wet twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yeast and brine.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, ssamjang, lemon juice, and honey.
Add the yeast mixture to the yogurt mixture and whisk until combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the egg mixture to the yogurt mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25 minutes or until set.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
